environment.database: local PostgreSQL, disposable schema per test

checks: TEXT and DM mention UUIDs are persisted with messages and returned on idempotent retry
TEXT user rename does not alter stored mention UUIDs
DM mention outside the participant pair is rejected atomically, including administrator
edit replaces mentions; soft deletion hides mentions from history and counters
caller-local mention counts exclude own messages and messages at or before read cursor
third-party administrator cannot read DM history

limitations: Local PostgreSQL integration only; no production deploy or release-gate claim.
